pair_weighting.pairnf_z40: BT vs incumbent pick, every passing better/worse pair weight 1 (pair_nf)
pair_weighting.pgap_z40: pair weight |t_j - t_inc| / spread_c (passing-fitness std of the context, training labels), renormalized to mean 1 over the context's active pairs (pgap = 1.0)
pair_weighting.pm25_z40: pairs with |t_j - t_inc| <= 0.25 spread_c dropped (strict-improvement dead zone, pmarg = 0.25); remaining pairs weight 1
pair_weighting.shared: 16 steps, lr 3e-4, slate 192, keep 48, same pointwise/listwise/hinge terms, z >= 0.40 gate, rng_arm = pairnf (all random streams shared)

primary_metric: median over seeds of pooled OOF Elo vs incumbent with 95% family-bootstrap CI; non-floor Elo co-primary
selection: max mean non-floor OOF Elo over partitions (tie: pooled gain)
strict: pooled gain > 0.002 and CI low > 0; Elo > 0 and CI low > 0; non-floor Elo CI low > 0; Elo > 0 per partition; paired family-bootstrap arm-control CI low > 0; ties never win
lift_rule: a non-control arm passes strict and beats the control (paired CI low > 0) on every seed, val91 not_worse on every seed, median val91 gain with cross-seed family-bootstrap CI low > 0, clean red-team; otherwise NO_LIFT
redteam_prereg: floor-recovery split: report gain with and without -2.0 floor recoveries; a paired NON-FLOOR gain CI > 0 vs control is the mechanism test
mechanism: non-floor W/L of the arm's extra kept changes (> 57% predicted) and of the control changes it drops
kept < 0.5x control => gate-starved; kept > 2x control => z-inflated
control CV cells copied from H472 fold_sig (= H471 cells; sha list identical); fresh control re-check in smoke (8d5ac793) and probe (5f3acc50)
ties never win; val91 gain ~0 with >= 85/91 ties is not evidence; report single-context val91 drivers
equal pooled Elo with equal W-L = arithmetic coincidence once adapters differ
pair weights / dead zone use training-fold fitness only; val91 read once per seed for the selected arm only

control_cells_reused_from_h472.sha256_list: control_fold_sig_from_h472.sha256 (in scratch dir; byte-identical to H472 control_fold_sig_from_h471.sha256)

task_verdict_rule: LIFT only if the median val91 gain is beyond its cross-seed family-bootstrap CI (CI low > 0) AND the pre-registered LIFT rule holds (strict + beats control every seed + not_worse); else NO_LIFT

redteam_specific.c_seed3_pm25_p0cv1_p1cv1: each one floor recovery +2.13 (+0.0087 of fold mean); non-floor +0.0021 (ctrl +0.0023) and +0.0028 (ctrl +0.0008); control recovers the same floors on every seed; p1cv1 minibatch loss 12.95->13.21 (5/140 cells end higher; single-batch noise)
redteam_specific.d_ties: OOF ties 2204-2235 of 2438; val91 ties 83-84 of 91

aggregate.metric: utility = -fitness of argmin-predicted pool program (-2.0 on gate fail); higher is better
aggregate.strict_rule: pooled OOF gain > 0.002 AND gain CI low > 0 AND pooled Elo > 0 AND Elo CI low > 0 AND non-floor Elo CI low > 0 AND Elo > 0 on each partition; selection = max mean non-floor OOF Elo over partitions; counts only if it also beats the control (paired family-bootstrap gain CI low > 0)
aggregate.h470_task_verdict_rule: LIFT only if the median val91 gain is beyond 0 with the cross-seed family-bootstrap CI low > 0 AND the pre-registered LIFT rule holds; else NO_LIFT
